column2: Figma icon sets -> @skai/ui icon exports. Harvested 2026-08-11.
icons/* is 27,591 of the design system's 54,047 placements — over half of it.
The Figma sets carry 126 distinct icons:
src/figma-icons.tsx exports 90 `Figma*Icon` components, and src/icons.ts calls
them "traced from the design file... what parity is measured against".
★ THE TWO SETS ARE NOT NAME-ALIGNED. Of the 36 icons in the five sets that were
fully enumerated, exactly FIVE have a same-named code export (info, people,
share, vault, warning). The code vocabulary is sidebar/social/chain heavy
(sidebar*, discord, instagram, solana, bnb, basechain, xlogo, backtest,
crystalball); the Figma vocabulary is wallet-action and tier heavy (Buy,
Receive, Bridge, Approvals, Batch, Backup, Spending, Insight, Request,
So nobody can currently tell whether a given Figma icon is implemented. A
name mismatch here is NOT proof an icon is missing — the code may draw the
same glyph under another name — but it does mean coverage is unverifiable by
inspection, which is why "wrong icon" is 12% of the open bug backlog.
Resolving a `candidate` row means opening both glyphs and comparing. Do not
promote one on name similarity alone.
exact     — same name in both. Safe to rely on.
candidate — plausible counterpart by role; UNVERIFIED, compare the glyphs.
none      — no plausible code export found. Likely genuinely unimplemented.
Only the five fully-enumerated sets are listed. icons/action (56) and
icons/graphical (33) still need their variant lists harvested.
